technical-summary: Promote rad0037 (bf16_fp8 KV), rad0038 (bf16_i8 KV), rad0040 (one KV layout table) and rad0041 (Flash-Next b16 rows) into serving-core through the lightweight profile-evidence tier, with Qwen3.8-27B and Flash-Next as the named models. The layouts are opt-in --kv-cache-dtype values; default caches are unchanged (identity at the KLD float floor on both models).
user-summary-candidate: Radiance can serve Qwen3.8-27B and Flash-Next with two new KV cache types, bf16_i8 and bf16_fp8, that hold about 1.3x more tokens than bf16 at lower error than fp8 on 27B. They are opt-in via --kv-cache-dtype; the default caches are unchanged. On Flash-Next, KLD cannot separate cache error from the model's own numeric noise, so quality there is shown by a retrieval probe only.
